problem_text:
A logistics firm must coordinate a circuit of ten regional warehouses for a critical equipment audit. The facility locations are as follows:

Warehouse Alpha: Coordinates (133,34)
Warehouse Beta: Coordinates (146,133)
Warehouse Gamma: Coordinates (160,53)
Warehouse Delta: Coordinates (136,26)
Warehouse Epsilon: Coordinates (105,162)
Warehouse Zeta: Coordinates (139,103)
Warehouse Eta: Coordinates (189,199)
Warehouse Theta: Coordinates (71,74)
Warehouse Iota: Coordinates (113,95)
Warehouse Kappa: Coordinates (145,160)

The travel distances, in kilometers, between pairs of facilities are predetermined:
Alpha to Gamma: 33.0 km
Alpha to Delta: 8.5 km
Alpha to Epsilon: 131.0 km
Alpha to Zeta: 69.3 km
Alpha to Eta: 174.2 km
Alpha to Theta: 73.8 km
Alpha to Iota: 64.2 km
Alpha to Kappa: 126.6 km
Beta to Gamma: 81.2 km
Beta to Delta: 107.5 km
Beta to Epsilon: 50.2 km
Beta to Zeta: 30.8 km
Beta to Eta: 78.8 km
Beta to Theta: 95.4 km
Beta to Iota: 50.3 km
Beta to Kappa: 27.0 km
Gamma to Delta: 36.1 km
Gamma to Epsilon: 122.1 km
Gamma to Zeta: 54.2 km
Gamma to Eta: 148.9 km
Gamma to Theta: 91.4 km
Gamma to Iota: 63.0 km
Gamma to Kappa: 108.0 km
Delta to Epsilon: 139.5 km
Delta to Zeta: 77.1 km
Delta to Eta: 180.9 km
Delta to Theta: 80.8 km
Delta to Iota: 72.7 km
Delta to Kappa: 134.3 km
Epsilon to Zeta: 68.1 km
Epsilon to Eta: 91.8 km
Epsilon to Theta: 94.3 km
Epsilon to Iota: 67.5 km
Epsilon to Kappa: 40.0 km
Zeta to Eta: 108.2 km
Zeta to Theta: 73.9 km
Zeta to Iota: 27.2 km
Zeta to Kappa: 57.3 km
Eta to Theta: 171.9 km
Eta to Iota: 128.8 km
Eta to Kappa: 58.8 km
Theta to Iota: 47.0 km
Theta to Kappa: 113.5 km
Iota to Kappa: 72.4 km

Due to a permanent access restriction, no direct route exists between Warehouse Alpha and Warehouse Beta. Furthermore, a routing directive stipulates that precisely one of the following two key corridors must be incorporated into the final circuit: the link between Beta and Gamma, or the link between Gamma and Delta.

The objective is to determine the minimal total travel distance for a closed-loop inspection tour that visits every warehouse exactly one time, concluding at the point of origin.
